# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 52 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_052_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 52

**1** His disciples said to him: "Twenty-four [меhоу снаоу] prophets [профнтнс] spoke in Israel [іhл] and they all spoke in you."

**2** He said to them: "You have disregarded [хааq] the living one who is in your presence, and you have spoken about the dead."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *меhоу снаоу*: twenty-four; the number of books in the Hebrew canon (by ancient counting)
- *профнтнс*: prophets
- "Spoke in you" — they prophesied about Jesus; the disciples claim the Hebrew prophets pointed to him
- "The living one who is in your presence" — Jesus himself, alive and present; "living" is *onh*, the same root as "living Father" and "living Jesus"
- "Spoken about the dead" — the prophets, however great, are dead; the living one is here
- The disciples are biblically literate but blind to the living teacher before them
- cf. John 5:39: "You search the Scriptures... yet you refuse to come to me"
